name: Norway
dossier:
The Norway national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Løvene, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 31 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A goal machine and a captain-artist finally on the biggest stage together.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Norway will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group I and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group I. The connection between Erling Haaland and Martin Ødegaard is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Erling Haaland - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Norway are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Norway return to the World Cup after a 28-year absence  -  and they're bringing Erling Haaland with them.
Norway boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Round of 16 (1998).
